Here, the user simply runs with the ball in a straight line. For this technique, the user must have some muscular strength but also have full determination to enter the penalty area, in order to have an opportunity to score. The only way to keep on dribbling in a straight line in that case is to break through the players forcibly, so in order to successfully break through, the user must be stronger physically than his opponent.

By putting a rotation effect on the ball, but hitting the ball stronger compared to the Drive Shot beforehand, the ball will go straightwise and fall sharply just before the keeper is about to catch it . By keeping this original shot secret that far in the tournament for victory purposes even so, the shot effect was simple for Tsubasa to mimick it .
